items.name: Uniqueness audit: zero duplicate signatures in a 20-minute soak
Seeded identities: name, age, home, job, income, traits, mood, likes, relationships
Identity visibly changes gait, posture, reactions, talk and decisions
Daily schedules per district and hour (rush hour, noon beach, 1 AM clubs, dawn crews, opening routines)
Schedule test: one district sampled every game hour
Tier D street activities (coffee line, dominoes, fruit cart, unloading, car wash, dog walks, performers, food-truck line, smokers, couples, tourists, kids, construction, fishermen, bus stops)
Beach life: sunbathers, umbrellas, volleyball, swimmers, lifeguards in towers
General sit system shared with the player (game.sit.nearest)
Group behavior and NPC-to-NPC conversations
Reactions by personality: gunfire (flee, freeze, fight, call 911, film), crash crowds, helping the injured
Honk reactions: jump back, yell, flip off
Comments on outfit, car, weather, time and what the player just did
Home intrusion reactions: scream, call 911, grab a bat
Witness reports with accurate or flawed descriptions (witness event for police)
Ragdolls for cars, falls and explosions; paramedics sometimes arrive
Line bank: thousands of original lines by personality, context, district, time, weather, relationship
Smart line picker and repeat-rate measurement
NPCs speak with purpose: hiring, flirting, deals, warnings, asking for help
Dialogue wheel with real outcomes (job, discount, friend, fight, police call)
Subtitles, speech bubbles and voice blips
Optional AI dialogue hook (off by default, no key shipped)
Memory across days, persisted through the save API
Named locals with lore, schedules, memory, deals and jobs
Influencer flavor: ring lights, selfies, livestreaming crimes
Scale: 300+ visible people with LODs, instanced crowd and time-sliced AI at 60 fps
Reaction tests with outcome distributions by personality
Dialogue test: every wheel option to its outcome
Street-life screenshots: 6 places x 3 times of day, reviewed
Liveliness comparison with ref_30 and ref_35
